parts.name: Rear Wheel
parts.description: A 16-inch cast-aluminum rear wheel with a 150/80-16 Dunlop tire. It carries the rear brake disc and the final-driven sprocket.
parts.function: Turns chain drive into forward motion and carries most of the rider's weight.

oem.note: 2026 Rebel 500 ABS (CMX500AAC) diagram. Only the final-driven sprocket's part number is recorded here.

parts.name: Rear Wheel (Cast Rim)
parts.description: A 16-inch cast-aluminum wheel. The spoke design shown is representative.
parts.function: Holds the tire and connects it to the hub, the sprocket carrier and the brake disc.
parts.verificationNote: Search results disagreed about the 2026 rear-wheel part number, so it is not recorded. Not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A.

parts.name: Rear Tire 150/80-16
parts.description: A Dunlop 150/80-16 tire. Its outside diameter in the 3D view is calculated from the tire size.
parts.function: Puts engine power to the road and supports most of the load.

parts.name: Rear Axle
parts.description: The axle through the rear hub and the swingarm ends. Chain tension is normally set by moving the axle.
parts.function: Locates the rear wheel in the swingarm. Its position sets chain slack and wheel alignment.
parts.verificationNote: The adjuster type, part number and torque spec are not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A.

service.notes: Torque specification not yet verified. Consult the Honda service manual (61MLH00).

parts.name: Final Drive (Chain & Sprockets)
parts.description: A #520 chain running from a 15-tooth drive sprocket to a 40-tooth driven sprocket: a 2.67:1 final reduction (40 ÷ 15).
parts.function: Carries power from the transmission output shaft to the rear wheel and multiplies torque by the sprocket ratio.

parts.name: Drive Sprocket (15T)
parts.description: The small 15-tooth front sprocket on the transmission countershaft. Its pitch diameter in the 3D view is calculated from 15 teeth at #520 pitch.
parts.function: Pulls the chain using the output of the gearbox.
parts.verificationNote: The tooth count is Honda-published. The part number is not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A.

parts.name: Drive Chain (#520)
parts.description: A #520 roller chain on the left side of the bike.
parts.function: Links the two sprockets. It needs periodic cleaning, lubrication and slack adjustment.
parts.verificationNote: Chain size is Honda-published. Link count, slack specification and part number are not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A.

parts.name: Driven Sprocket (40T)
parts.description: The 40-tooth rear sprocket bolted to the rear wheel. Its pitch diameter in the 3D view is calculated from 40 teeth at #520 pitch.
parts.function: Receives the chain's pull and turns the rear wheel.

oem.note: Listed on the 2026 Rebel 500 ABS (CMX500AAC) REAR WHEEL diagram, read via search index. The 40T count matches Honda's 2026 spec. Confirm on the linked fiche before ordering.
